**No additional correction is necessary for the eight Planar reference mirrors. The complete named FXC06 authored-evidence requirement is covered at its disclosed inputs.**

Schedule108’s receipt is recorded without repeating its settled review. Neither finding approves parent335, applies canonical files or establishes game-runtime behavior.

## 1. Planar mirror follow-through — confirmed

```text
CONFIRM_EXACT_FT107_REFERENCE_MIRROR_FOLLOWTHROUGH_IN_EIGHT_BOUND_DERIVED_FILES
```

The **eight JSON replacements and three text replacements** reproduce all eight complete successor files and reverse to their exact complete baselines. Their Planar-related changes agree with the selected FT107 decision.

The private/public reading, acquisition contract, all three current acquisition-assembly procedure mirrors, current chapter, source-audit chapter and payload chapter consistently distinguish:

**Ordinary Planar Binding:** the exact accepted AC5 card is current ordinary-spell source evidence.

**The separate Planar feat:** `payloadOperational` remains **null**, with selection, exact approval and runtime approval still **false**. No cast, charge payment, target admission or service record is authorized through that wrapper.

The complete former dependency, original `sourceDirection`, questions, source objects and examples remain preserved. The public chapter explicitly identifies the older undefined-payload examples as historical. **Astral Projection is unchanged and unavailable.**

The later **ACQ106 baseline** is correctly used. Its only changes are the three identified Planar procedure strings. All **177 allowance-descriptor references and their authority binding** remain unchanged. The standalone descriptor file is referenced rather than supplied in this narrow packet, so this is not a new semantic review of all177 descriptors or the full acquisition assembly.

The other283 ordinary dependency cards remain unchanged; Planar’s complete replacement equals FT107’s selected current dependency. **I found no concrete inconsistency requiring another wording change.**

## 2. FXC06 — named authored-evidence requirement covered

```text
FXC06_NAMED_AUTHORED_EVIDENCE_REQUIREMENT_COVERED_AT_DISCLOSED_INPUTS
```

I compared the complete named requirement against its original acceptance contract, the actual retained case objects, the accepted FT84 procedures/questions and the supplied mapping—not merely the case counts.

| Named evidence area | Original cases | Later accepted FT84 cases |
|---|---:|---:|
| Foraging and actual provisioning | 15 | 0 |
| Endurance, rest debt and cause counters | 13 | 0 |
| Manufacturing and closed construction | 14 | 22 |
| Research time, phase credit and exclusions | 8 | 17 |
| Spell copying, written ritual learning and bills | 6 | 14 |
| Ritual casting and actual helpers | 24 | 0 |
| Other explicit time compositions | 12 | 0 |
| Whole short-rest repairs versus long-job tails | 14 | 4 |
| **Total** | **106** | **57** |

Every original and later case maps to exactly one area. Their **complete objects** match the preserved evidence.

The coverage includes the genuine480-active-minute forage Watch; distinct person/mule demands; finite stock and no oil/sundry/Supply creation; separate Endurance cause counters; unpaid deadline and later missed Rest Watch; exact and late safe-rest completion; suppression, acquisition and retained history; unrelated shortages; and the two-work-Watch ceiling.

It also covers source-specific discount composition, actual assistants, fixed waits, interruptions and phase precision. The three accepted FT84 answers supply the written-copy/material predicate, **only the two named research-clock completions**, and the authorized-creation distinction between Contraption, Trapsetter and expressly excluded processes.

The repair evidence distinguishes **whole20/30-minute jobs** from a31-minute job and the last20minutes of an eight-hour reconstruction. It preserves stock, completed-work identity, current-HP limits and already-spent charges, service and fuel.

### Supersession is now stated precisely

**Zero original numerical outcomes are replaced.** All78 conditional work cases and28 source-qualified time/provision cases remain exact.

What changed through FT84 was the disposition of the **three previously unselected interface questions and six operative procedures**. The57 later cases supply that follow-through; they do not overwrite the106 original cases.

For example, the old unclassified-bill case rejects an unsupported **material discount**, not lawful copying altogether. The accepted full-price ambiguous-bill case preserves the independent half-time benefit. No contradictory current rule was identified.

## 3. What this does not close

The seven FT84 holds remain, including actual-world credentials, texts, stock and safe work; the missing full gadget activation table; unseen/future mirrors; other research clocks; runtime; and human/balance/cosmology/release gates.

The recipe121 work example does not become proof of complete manufacturing output settlement. A named clamp result does not supply its missing activation profile. **These limits do not leave an uncovered item in the named FXC06 authored-evidence requirement; they remain their separate obligations.**

No parent acceptance flag is changed. FXC07/08/09 and the whole335 exact review remain separate.

## Verification and delivery

**618 fresh read-only source, full-byte reconstruction, mirror and evidence-mapping checks passed.** Historical acceptance88, FT84, mapping108, Planar108 and Schedule109 check counts remain inherited reports—not fresh reruns.

No supplied executable, earlier successful program, original case runner or game module was executed.

**File:** `DD_Joint_Followthrough_109_Review_01.zip`  
**Actual bytes:** **25,079**  
**SHA256:**
```text
23659921391528e0845879a6d68f4bdc8fd7703928da3ae6bad3ee0961df8d92
```

The ZIP exists, was reopened, and passed CRC, safe-member and all four manifest-file bindings. It contains five files including the manifest, and **no executable or large unchanged input**.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="4"}[Download the SHA256 sidecar](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Joint_Followthrough_109_Review_01.zip.sha256)

**Applied525/323/249/173 and53 accepted-but-unapplied ordinary spells remain unchanged.** All five whole-positive-case holds, separate bestiary obligations and the owner’s implementation reservation remain in force.
